question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Perilous
solution:
The correct answer is **Safe.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word is **Safe**.
 
• **Safe** means **safeguarded against or not exposed to danger or risk. **
 
• **Perilous **means are **full of danger or risk.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is** Safe.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Verbose Means **utilising or expressing more words than are required. (वाचाल)**
 
• **Unstable **Means are **likely to give way; not stable. (अस्थिर)**
 
• **Cruel **Means **wilfully causing pain or suffering to others or feeling no concern about it. (निर्दयी****)**
